item_name: Shopify Plus brands without a dedicated ops stack
hypothesis: Shopify Plus stores install 2.6x more apps than standard but >80% have no manufacturing/ops tool. 'Run on spreadsheets + Klaviyo' pattern. Clean wedge.

market_sizing.target_buyer: Founder, COO, or Head of Ops at a Shopify Plus brand. Decision is often made jointly with the agency or fractional COO. The brand has hit a complexity threshold (BOM/kit complexity, supplier coordination, expansion to wholesale or 3PL) where spreadsheets are visibly breaking.
market_sizing.business_count_au: ~700-1,100 AU Shopify Plus stores total (BuiltWith + Shopify Plus AU partner directory signals). Estimated 60-75% have no dedicated manufacturing/ops tool = ~450-800 in-segment AU [uncertain].
market_sizing.business_count_secondary: US ~22,000-28,000 Plus stores (largest market by far, ~70-80% no-ops-stack); UK ~4,500-6,000; NZ ~200-300; CA ~1,500-2,200. AU is small in absolute terms but well-suited to founder-led motion. [uncertain] — based on BuiltWith and Shopify public claims.
market_sizing.typical_size: 10-50 FTE, AU$3M-AU$30M revenue (Plus threshold is ~AU$1M GMV but most Plus brands sit above $3M). Larger than Tier A indie segments and Tier B defection cohorts.
market_sizing.annual_revenue_band_aud: $3M-$20M most common, with $30M+ tail. Pro ($499) tier candidates almost exclusively.
market_sizing.growth_trend: Shopify Plus AU base growing 12-18% YoY (Shopify public statements + AU partner ecosystem expansion). The 'no-ops-stack' subset is structurally durable — Plus brands often consciously avoid bloated MRP systems and rely on spreadsheets + Klaviyo + 3PL portal. Manuva-shaped flat-priced ops layer is a new affordable wedge that didn't exist 3 years ago.
market_sizing.seasonality_intensity: 3 — Plus brands hit ops-pain right after peak seasons (Q1 after holiday Q4, mid-Q3 after EOFY stocktake). Buying windows: late Jan/early Feb and late July.

fit_and_timing.manuva_fit_score: 4 — Manuva's data model (BOMs/kits, allocation, POs, locations, lot tracking, Shopify integration) maps cleanly to the typical Plus brand running spreadsheets. The fit gap is depth in capacity planning, demand forecasting, and channel reconciliation — most no-ops-stack Plus brands don't need those yet but will within 12 months. Phase 1 sweet spot: brands at the spreadsheet-breaking moment.
fit_and_timing.addressable_window: now for Shopify-only Plus brands; gated on Amazon/Woo connectors for multi-channel Plus brands (~30% of segment); gated on Xero/MYOB for accounting-tight buyers.
roadmap_dependency: Klaviyo data sync (not blocking but expected as part of stack)
fit_and_timing.typical_tier: Pro ($499) for ~70% of segment; Growth ($249) for the smaller end (sub-$5M revenue Plus brands).
fit_and_timing.regulatory_burden: 2 — Plus brands span all verticals (apparel, beauty, food, supplements, homewares). Compliance burden is vertical-driven not segment-driven. Average is modest.
fit_and_timing.lot_batch_criticality: 3 — Required for ~35-40% (beauty, supplements, food, candle Plus brands); nice-to-have for the rest. Manuva's pre-launch lot tracking covers must-haves.
fit_and_timing.time_to_value_days: 7-14 days. No incumbent to migrate from (spreadsheet is the 'incumbent') — faster TTV than defection segments. Bottleneck: BOM/kit setup + opening stock import.

economics.incumbent_pricing: Stack today: Shopify Plus base US$2,300/mo (~AU$3,500), Klaviyo US$150-600/mo (~AU$230-920), Gorgias / Zendesk US$60-300/mo (~AU$90-460), 3PL portal included. Manufacturing/ops layer: $0 (spreadsheets) for ~60-75% of the segment; the remainder use Stock Sync / Sumtracker / Katana ($99-$199/mo). Total ops-stack spend below MRP layer: AU$300-800/mo. The wedge: Manuva at AU$499 fits cleanly inside existing stack budgets.
economics.willingness_to_pay_aud: $499/mo Pro tier is well within budget — Plus brands routinely add apps at $200-400/mo. WTP is high; price is not the barrier. The barrier is 'why now / why this app'.
economics.expansion_revenue_potential: 5 — Highest expansion potential of any segment. Plus brands grow fast and add complexity (wholesale, retail, Amazon, multi-warehouse) — Manuva can land at Pro and grow via add-on modules (capacity planning, lot-tracking deep, wholesale portal). NRR potential 120-140%.
economics.churn_risk: 3 — Plus brands churn faster than B2B distributors (founder turnover, acquisition events, agency-driven stack consolidation). Counterweight: switching cost grows quickly once BOMs and POs are in.
economics.cac_estimate_aud: Cash CAC: AU$200-500 (LinkedIn ads to ops/COO titles, retargeting Shopify-Plus content). Founder-time CAC: 15-25 hours/close (longer discovery cycles, agency intros, COO meeting cycles) × AU$150 = AU$2,250-3,750. Blended notional CAC AU$2,500-4,200. Cash out-of-pocket AU$200-500 + ~18 founder hours.
economics.cash_cac_affordability: 3 — Higher cash CAC than defection segments because intent search volume is lower and outbound to busy COOs is slower. Affordable but not 'free' — needs ~AU$200-500/customer in retargeting / agency-event sponsorship. Within solo-founder budget but tighter.
economics.ltv_estimate_aud: AU$430 ARPU × 80% margin × ~30 months × 1.25 NRR ≈ AU$12,900 LTV (boosted by expansion). Highest LTV in Tier B.
economics.typical_seat_count: 5-15 users typical. Not the primary buying lever (Manuva flat-priced) but Plus brands appreciate not adding seat-counting overhead.
economics.multi_channel_count: 2-4 typical (Shopify + wholesale + Amazon + retail). Highest multi-channel mix of any segment.
economics.wholesale_b2b_mix: 20-50% wholesale (segment-bimodal — pure D2C Plus brands ~20%, hybrid D2C+wholesale ~50%).

where_they_live.primary_channels: LinkedIn: 'Shopify Plus' / 'DTC Operators' / 'Ecommerce Australia' groups (~30-60k cross-membership); Slack/Discord: '2PM' DTC community, 'Operators Guild' (~1,500 members), 'Shopify Plus Operators' (~800 members); Twitter/X DTC ecosystem (Eli Weiss, Nik Sharma, Daniel Murray, Aussie voices like Kate Morris, Mark Capps); Reddit r/Shopify (~150k), r/ecommerce (~200k). [uncertain] member counts.
where_they_live.directories_communities: Shopify Plus Partner Directory (AU agencies: Convert Digital, eStar, Pixc, Magia Digital, etc.); BuiltWith Shopify Plus filter; 'AU Shopify Plus' lists curated by agencies; The Lumery / Power Retail brand lists; Practical Ecommerce + Modern Retail reader bases; Klaviyo customer directory (overlaps ~80%).
where_they_live.industry_facebook_group_size: ~10-20k across 'Shopify Australia', 'Australian E-commerce', 'DTC Founders AU' [uncertain]. Less active than LinkedIn/Slack for this cohort — FB skews smaller brands.
where_they_live.podcasts_voices: DTC Pod (Eli Weiss, Ramon Berrios), 2PM newsletter (Web Smith), The Modern Retail Podcast, Lenny's Newsletter (B2B-shifted but ops content lands), AU: Add To Cart podcast (Nathan Bush), Power Retail's 'eCommerce News' weekly. YouTube: Aaron Orendorff, Brett Curry. Twitter: Eli Weiss, Nik Sharma, Daniel Murray.
where_they_live.events_trade_shows: Shopify Editions (online, free, AU watch-party clusters); Shopify Unite (annual, US, AU sends 50-100 attendees); Online Retailer (Sydney, ~6k attendees, June); Retail Global (Gold Coast, ~3k, May); Add To Cart Live (Melb/Sydney, ~500-800); Klaviyo:BOS (AU-relevant via livestream). Sponsorship <AU$10k: Add To Cart Live, Retail Global side-events. Shopify Plus AU agency events (Convert Digital, eStar) are highest-leverage at AU$1-3k.
where_they_live.search_keywords: 'Shopify Plus inventory app', 'Shopify Plus manufacturing app', 'Shopify Plus ops stack', 'BOM app for Shopify', 'Shopify kit / bundle inventory', 'Shopify Plus 3PL integration', 'spreadsheet inventory Shopify', 'Shopify B2B wholesale inventory', 'Shopify Plus warehouse management', 'manufacturing app Shopify Plus AU'.
where_they_live.community_density: 4 — High. LinkedIn + Slack/Discord DTC operator communities are dense, English-speaking, and warm to founder-led outreach. Easier to find than scattered MRPeasy defectors.
where_they_live.founder_persona_homogeneity: 4 — Strong persona homogeneity: 30-45 year old e-commerce native, hired or first-hire COO, agency-connected, KPI-driven (LTV/CAC/contribution margin). Messaging compounds across the segment.

outreach_fit.cold_outbound_feasibility: 4 — High. BuiltWith + Shopify Plus partner directory + LinkedIn Sales Navigator gives clean targeting. AU Plus base is finite (~700-1,100 stores), so a full TAM walk in 6 months is feasible. Cold-call is less acceptable; LinkedIn DM + email is standard. Agency intros are warmer.
outreach_fit.inbound_content_fit: 4 — Good but not exceptional. 'Shopify Plus ops stack', 'Spreadsheet replacement Shopify', 'When to add manufacturing to Shopify Plus' content ranks reasonably. Competition from Shopify itself + DTC newsletters is heavier than for defection segments. Best paired with operator-community content (Slack/LinkedIn long-form).
outreach_fit.founder_market_fit_proxy: 4 — DTC operators don't need vertical credentials but they do scrutinise tooling closely. Kasper's PAC Tech + Manuva ops/tech background plays well. Need 1-2 named-logo case studies before this segment will move at scale — chicken-and-egg solved by landing 1-2 Plus brands early via warm intros.
outreach_fit.case_study_acquisition_cost: High — Plus brands are picky about lending their logo. First 2-3 logos require equity-like effort (deep involvement, founder-attentive support, possibly discounted year). Subsequent logos compound much faster.
outreach_fit.case_study_appeal: 5 — Plus-brand logos carry huge reference value across Tier A and Tier B alike. A single recognisable AU Plus brand case study (e.g. an indie skincare or candle brand on Plus) doubles inbound across all segments.

foot_in_door_fit.design_partner_appeal: 4 — Stronger than defection segments. Plus brands are early-tech adopters and will trade roadmap input for founder access + discounted year. 'Design partner' framing fits 2-3 strategic logos especially around wholesale-pricing module, Amazon connector co-design, or capacity-planning preview.
foot_in_door_fit.paid_pilot_fit: 4 — Paid pilot at Pro $499 × 3-6 months credited works for the spreadsheet-replacement use-case. Plus brands have budget and prefer commitment over free.
foot_in_door_fit.free_trial_extension_fit: 2 — Free-for-X is counterproductive at Plus tier — signals 'not ready for our scale'. Skip.
foot_in_door_fit.trial_to_paid_benchmark: Paid pilot 40-60% (ChartMogul); CC-required 14-day trial 25-35%; agency-referred trial 50-70% (warm intros convert higher). Design-partner conversion 70-85% (highly self-selected).
foot_in_door_fit.reference_value: 5 — Highest reference value of any segment. Plus-brand logos punch above their weight in PR, ecosystem chatter, and agency channel.
foot_in_door_fit.recommended_foot_in_door_motion: Two-track motion. Track A (strategic, 2-3 logos in months 0-6): Design-partner program — 6 months free Pro + roadmap input + co-marketing + case study on launch. Target 2-3 named AU Plus brands via warm intro through Shopify Plus AU agency partners (Convert Digital, eStar, Pixc). Track B (volume, months 3-12): Paid pilot at Pro $499 × 3 months credited, sourced via LinkedIn outbound + agency referrals + Shopify Plus AU partner events. Convert via 45-min discovery → pilot start within 10-14 days. Anchor inbound: 'How [Plus brand] replaced 5 spreadsheets with Manuva' long-form case study.
foot_in_door_fit.rollout_phase: Phase 1 (months 0-3) for design-partner track; Phase 2 (months 3-9) for paid-pilot volume; expansion into multi-channel Plus brands in Phase 3 (months 6-12) post-Amazon connector.

competitive_context.current_dominant_tool: Spreadsheets (Google Sheets / Excel) — 60-75% of segment. Other 25-40% split across Stock Sync, Sumtracker, Katana (light usage), Cin7 (heavier usage), and custom Airtable bases. Plus's native multi-location inventory covers basics — the gap is BOM/manufacturing/PO discipline.
competitive_context.switching_pain: 2 — Lower than any defection segment because spreadsheets are the incumbent. Migration is 'consolidate 3-5 spreadsheets into Manuva' — 8-15 founder hours. Lower switching cost cuts both ways: cheaper to land, easier to churn back to spreadsheets if value isn't visible by month 2.
competitive_context.competitor_gaps_for_this_segment: (1) Spreadsheets break at BOM versioning + multi-location + audit trail; (2) Shopify-native ops apps (Stock Sync, Sumtracker) lack manufacturing/BOM depth; (3) Katana per-seat doesn't fit Plus team sizes; (4) Cin7 is too heavy and expensive for 'just need BOMs + POs'; (5) Custom Airtable bases don't have allocation engines or PO logic; (6) Nothing in the segment offers Shopify-Plus-native + flat-priced + Xero-integrated ops layer.
competitive_context.user_satisfaction_signals: DTC operator Slacks (2PM, Operators Guild) regularly surface 'what are people using for BOMs / manufacturing on Plus?' with no consensus answer. LinkedIn posts from AU COOs lament spreadsheet fragility post-Black Friday. No single competitor has captured this segment — confirming the 'no-ops-stack' wedge is real. Specific quotes/threads [uncertain] without live re-query.
competitive_context.competitor_concentration: Fragmented — no incumbent above 20% share within this segment. Highest opportunity-to-concentration ratio of any Tier B segment.
competitive_context.integration_dependency_list: Shopify (must-have, shipped), Klaviyo (must-have for the brand-data overlap — not blocking but expected), Xero (~70%), Shippit / 3PL (eStore Logistics, James and James — high overlap), Amazon SP-API (~25%), Faire (~20%), Stripe, Gorgias/Zendesk (CS), Triple Whale / Northbeam (attribution — out of Manuva scope but stack-adjacent), Recharge (subscription Plus brands).

partner_channels.xero_myob_partner_channel_fit: 4 — Strong (~70% Xero overlap). Less of a primary acquisition channel than for defection segments because Plus brands' primary advisors are agencies + Klaviyo email partners, not bookkeepers. ProAdvisor referrals add a secondary stream.
partner_channels.shopify_app_store_acquisition_fit: 4 — Good. Plus brands install 2.6x more apps and actively browse the store for stack additions. Listing in 'Inventory & orders' / 'Manufacturing' / 'Stock management' categories surfaces Manuva to engaged buyers. Plus-tier brands prioritise apps with Shopify Plus Tech Partner badge.
partner_channels.shopify_plus_partner_potential: 5 — Highest-fit channel. Shopify Plus Tech Partner program (free to join with technical bar) opens managed-referral pipe via Shopify Plus Merchant Success Managers. Plus agencies (Convert Digital, eStar, Pixc, Magia Digital) field 'what ops/manufacturing app should we use?' from clients weekly. Strategic partnership with 2-3 AU Plus agencies is the single highest-leverage GTM move for this segment.
partner_channels.tpl_3pl_referral_potential: 4 — eStore Logistics, James and James, Shippit, Locad are common Plus-brand 3PL partners. Co-marketing webinar + referral fee structure works well. Higher fit than for defection segments.
partner_channels.industry_association_sponsorship: Add To Cart Live (Melb/Sydney, AU$3-6k); Online Retailer (Sydney, $8-15k booth + content); Power Retail Australian E-commerce Awards sponsorship $5-15k; Shopify Plus AU partner events $1-3k. Klaviyo:BOS Sydney roadshow side-sponsorship $3-8k. Total budget for Phase 1-2 events: AU$15-30k if pursued; not strictly required but high-ROI for case-study acquisition and agency intros.
partner_channels.partner_channel_potential: 5 — Best partner-channel composite of any segment. Shopify Plus Tech Partner + agency referrals + 3PL co-sell + Xero ProAdvisor + Klaviyo ecosystem all stack.

profitability_math.realistic_12mo_customer_count_solo: 4-8 paying customers in months 0-12 (lower count than defection segments due to longer sales cycle + higher onboarding bar but higher ARPU). Realistic landing: 6 customers, including 2 design partners + 4 paid pilots. Bandwidth: 20-30 hrs/customer onboarding (deeper than defection migration).
profitability_math.realistic_12mo_mrr_contribution_aud: AU$2,400-4,000 MRR by month 12 (6 customers × $430 blended ARPU = $2,580; upside to $4,000 with NRR expansion + 1-2 multi-channel Pro upsells).
profitability_math.path_to_first_3k_5k_mrr_aud: Strong contributor. Sequence: Months 0-3: warm-intro to 5-10 AU Plus agencies, sign 1 design-partner Plus brand at $0/mo (3-month free Pro, becomes $499/mo from month 4); build long-form case study for launch month 3-4. Months 3-6: 2nd design partner + 2 paid pilots ($499 × 3 mo credited). Months 6-9: case-study-led inbound starts ranking, sign 2 more paid pilots, convert previous pilots to annual. Months 9-12: agency-channel referrals add 1-2 more. End-month-12 MRR ~$2,400-3,000 from this segment + halo effect on indie cosmetics and other Tier A segments via reference logos. Combined with Unleashed defectors (item 19), comfortably clears AU$5K MRR by month 12.
profitability_math.customers_needed_for_1m_arr_aud: 194 customers at $430 ARPU. Realistic 3-year ramp: 60-90 customers (~12-18% of est. AU Plus no-ops segment). Strong contributor leg, anchored by agency channel.
profitability_math.solo_founder_bandwidth_fit: 3 — Onboarding is deeper than defection segments (20-30 hrs vs 10-15 hrs) and sales cycle longer (30-60 days vs 14-30). Manageable at 6-8 customers/year. Design-partner track absorbs disproportionate founder time but pays back in case-study leverage.
profitability_math.break_even_contribution_months: 2-3 months. $430 ARPU × 80% margin = $344 contribution/mo, recovering $200-500 cash CAC + ~20 founder hours within 2-3 months.
profitability_math.gross_margin_sensitivity: Moderate — Plus brand onboarding is heavier but plus-tier brands are operationally mature and don't need ongoing hand-holding. Steady-state gross margin ~80%. Design partners depress year-1 margin (3 months free) but compound case-study value.
profitability_math.priority_ranking: 2 — Top-3 overall priority and second within Tier B (behind Unleashed defectors on cash-CAC efficiency, ahead on LTV and reference value). Two-track motion (design partner + paid pilot) maximises both reference value and revenue. Anchor segment for the $1M ARR path.
profitability_math.risks_and_notes: (1) Shopify Plus Tech Partner application takes 2-4 weeks and requires technical review — submit in Phase 0; (2) Agency channel needs commission structure agreed upfront (typically 15-25% rev-share for year 1 or flat referral fee AU$500-1,500); (3) Design-partner program needs explicit terms (3-6 month free, roadmap input rights, case-study commitment, exclusivity carve-outs) — write a 1-page partner agreement; (4) Klaviyo data sync expectations may surface — confirm what 'integration' actually means before promising; (5) Some Plus brands genuinely don't need MRP (pure D2C with simple SKU lists) — pre-qualify on BOM complexity, multi-channel count, wholesale presence; (6) 3PL referrals create 'who owns the customer' tension with 3PL portals — clarify positioning as 'upstream of fulfilment' not competing; (7) Watch for Shopify itself adding inventory/manufacturing depth — Shopify Components / Linkpop / B2B native moves could compress the wedge; (8) Multi-channel Plus brands gated on Amazon connector — segment them out of Phase 1 motion; (9) Capture the first AU Plus design-partner logo by month 3 — single most important Phase-1 milestone; (10) Verify current Shopify Plus AU store count via BuiltWith + Shopify Plus partner directory before publishing TAM-derived claims.
